name: Adzviser WooCommerce
description:
Connect your WooCommerce store data to Claude. No more exporting CSVs or uploading files, Adzviser brings your reporting data directly into the conversation.

Ask about gross sales, returns, and items sold. Compare periods, dig into order level detail, and understand what's changed over time. Whether you're checking yesterday's sales or putting together a monthly report, start with a question and let Claude build the analysis you need.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Adzviser WooCommerce to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Adzviser WooCommerce to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://woocommerce.mcp.adzviser.com/http. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Adzviser WooCommerce MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adzviser WooCommerce provides these MCP tools: list_metrics_and_breakdowns_woo_commerce, list_workspace, and retrieve_reporting_data.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Adzviser WooCommerce?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Adzviser WooCommerce in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Adzviser WooCommerce MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adzviser WooCommerce requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Adzviser WooCommerce is developed by Adzviser LLC. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
